mapper.select: SELECT 'MEET' AS KIND , R.CORR_NO AS CORR_NO , R.TARE_FILE_NO AS IDEMPOTENCY_KEY , F.DOC_ID AS DOC_ID , X.FILEKEY AS FILE_KEY , CASE WHEN F.CMMN_FILE_ENC_YN = #{p.flagEncrypted} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS ENCRYPTED , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(1)) AS DECRYPT_KEY , R.TARE_FLPTH_NM AS SRC_FILE_PATH , R.TARE_FILE_NM AS SRC_FILE_NAME , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(1)) AS SOURCE_STT_PATH , R.CRT_DT AS OCCURRED_AT FROM ${p.tRerd} R INNER JOIN ${p.tImsc} P ON P.CORR_NO = R.CORR_NO AND P.PTCR_PRSR_RMV_YMD IS NULL AND P.SPECL_MNG_SE_CD IN #{cd} INNER JOIN ${p.tSmsm} F ON F.CMMN_FILE_ID = R.TBLT_VTR_FILE_ID AND F.DEL_YN = #{p.flagNotDeleted} LEFT JOIN ${p.tXvarm} X ON X.ELEMENTID = F.DOC_ID WHERE R.CRT_DT >= #{p.from} AND R.CRT_DT < #{p.to} AND R.DEL_YN = #{p.flagNotDeleted} AND R.RECRD_FILE_DEL_YN = #{p.flagNotDeleted} AND R.TBLT_VTR_FILE_ID IS NOT NULL ORDER BY R.CRT_DT, R.TARE_FILE_NO OFFSET #{p.offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{p.limit} ROWS ONLY

SELECT 'PHONE' AS KIND , U.CORR_NO AS CORR_NO , U.VRFC_ESTL_ID AS IDEMPOTENCY_KEY , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(1)) AS DOC_ID , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(1)) AS FILE_KEY , 1 AS ENCRYPTED , U.TELP_RECRD_FILE_ID AS DECRYPT_KEY , U.TELP_RECRD_FLPTH_NM AS SRC_FILE_PATH , U.TELP_RECRD_FILE_NM AS SRC_FILE_NAME , U.TELP_STT_FLPTH_NM AS SOURCE_STT_PATH , U.CRT_DT AS OCCURRED_AT FROM ${p.tImph} U INNER JOIN ${p.tImsc} P ON P.CORR_NO = U.CORR_NO AND P.PTCR_PRSR_RMV_YMD IS NULL AND P.SPECL_MNG_SE_CD IN #{cd} WHERE U.CRT_DT >= #{p.from} AND U.CRT_DT < #{p.to} AND U.TELP_PCALL_RECRD_YN = #{p.flagRecordedYes} AND U.DEL_DT IS NULL AND U.TELP_RECRD_FILE_ID IS NOT NULL ORDER BY U.CRT_DT, U.VRFC_ESTL_ID OFFSET #{p.offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{p.limit} ROWS ONLY

SELECT 'PHONE' AS KIND , U.CORR_NO AS CORR_NO , U.VRFC_ESTL_ID AS IDEMPOTENCY_KEY , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(1)) AS DOC_ID , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(1)) AS FILE_KEY , 1 AS ENCRYPTED , U.TELP_RECRD_FILE_ID AS DECRYPT_KEY , U.TELP_RECRD_FLPTH_NM AS SRC_FILE_PATH , U.TELP_RECRD_FILE_NM AS SRC_FILE_NAME , U.TELP_STT_FLPTH_NM AS SOURCE_STT_PATH , U.CRT_DT AS OCCURRED_AT FROM ${p.tImph} U WHERE U.CRT_DT >= #{p.from} AND U.CRT_DT < #{p.to} AND U.TELP_PTCR_PRSR_YN = #{p.flagPtcrYes} AND U.TELP_PCALL_RECRD_YN = #{p.flagRecordedYes} AND U.DEL_DT IS NULL AND U.TELP_RECRD_FILE_ID IS NOT NULL ORDER BY U.CRT_DT, U.VRFC_ESTL_ID OFFSET #{p.offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{p.limit} ROWS ONLY
